title: OpenClaw Inbox Zero: Let Your Agent Handle Email Before You Wake Up
summary: Set up OpenClaw to triage your inbox every morning — summarize important emails, draft replies for routine messages, and flag what needs your attention. Wake up to an empty inbox.
body_markdown: Tools like Superhuman and Inbox Zero are SaaS products with fixed features — you get what they've built. OpenClaw is a configurable AI agent you control: the triage rules in SOUL.md are entirely yours, the schedule in HEARTBEAT.md is yours, and you can add any behavior you can describe in plain language. If you want the agent to cross-reference your calendar before drafting a meeting reply, you can add that. The ceiling is much higher because you're configuring an agent, not using a product.
